period: a length or portion of time
The company reported strong growth over the last financial period.
since: from a particular time in the past until now, or because
He has lived in this city since he graduated from university.
began: The meeting began an hour later than planned.
kept: continued to have, hold, or maintain something
The recipe was kept secret within the family for generations.
digitally: All the old files have now been stored digitally on the server.
end: the final part or point of something
Save the best joke for the end of your speech.
up: towards a higher place or position
Neighbourhoods with few trees and little open space heat up fastest.
thinner: comparative of thin; having less thickness or density
The soup tasted thinner after she added more water.
historical: relating to history or past events
The museum displays several historical documents from the war.
record: a written or stored account of facts or events
The hospital keeps a detailed record of every patient's treatment.
than: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
This year's harvest was larger than last year's.
less: He eats less meat now than he used to.
far: to a great extent; at or to a great distance
This plan works far better than the last one did.
forgets: He often forgets where he left his phone.
unless: except if; on the condition that something does not happen
Unless something marks it as worth keeping, it is allowed to fade.
continuously: The alarm rang continuously until someone finally switched it off.
reminded: The old photograph reminded her of her childhood village.
